INSERT INTO T_REPORT(REPORT_ID, PLAYER_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, TYPE, READ_FLAG, SAVE_FLAG, RECEIVE_TIME) VALUES(#reportID#, #playerID#, #title#, #content#, #type#, #readFlag#, #saveFlag#, SYSDATE())
SELECT @@IDENTITY AS ID
sqlMap.update: UPDATE T_REPORT SET REPORT_ID=#reportID#, PLAYER_ID=#playerID#, TITLE=#title#, CONTENT=#content#, TYPE=#type#, READ_FLAG=#readFlag#, SAVE_FLAG=#saveFlag#, RECEIVE_TIME=#receiveTime# WHERE Report_ID=#reportID#
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM T_REPORT WHERE SAVE_FLAG=0 AND (SYSDATE() > RECEIVE_TIME + INTERVAL #day# DAY)
sqlMap.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_REPORT WHERE READ_FLAG=#readFlag# AND PLAYER_ID=#playerID#

SELECT REPORT_ID AS reportID, PLAYER_ID AS playerID, TITLE AS title, CONTENT AS content, TYPE AS type, READ_FLAG AS readFlag, SAVE_FLAG AS saveFlag, RECEIVE_TIME AS receiveTime FROM T_REPORT WHERE Report_ID=#reportID#

SELECT REPORT_ID AS reportID, PLAYER_ID AS playerID, TITLE AS title, CONTENT AS content, TYPE AS type, READ_FLAG AS readFlag, SAVE_FLAG AS saveFlag, RECEIVE_TIME AS receiveTime FROM T_REPORT ORDER BY RECEIVE_TIME DESC
sqlMap.update: UPDATE T_REPORT SET SAVE_FLAG=1 WHERE Report_ID=#reportID#
UPDATE T_REPORT SET READ_FLAG=1 WHERE REPORT_ID=#reportID#
sqlMap.select: SELECT REPORT_ID AS reportID, PLAYER_ID AS playerID, TITLE AS title, CONTENT AS content, TYPE AS type, READ_FLAG AS readFlag, SAVE_FLAG AS saveFlag, RECEIVE_TIME AS receiveTime FROM T_REPORT WHERE PLAYER_ID=#playerID# ORDER BY RECEIVE_TIME DESC

SELECT REPORT_ID AS reportID, PLAYER_ID AS playerID, TITLE AS title, CONTENT AS content, TYPE AS type, READ_FLAG AS readFlag, SAVE_FLAG AS saveFlag, RECEIVE_TIME AS receiveTime FROM T_REPORT WHERE PLAYER_ID=#playerID# AND TYPE=#type# ORDER BY RECEIVE_TIME DESC LIMIT #start#,#offset#
SELECT count(*) FROM T_REPORT WHERE PLAYER_ID=#playerID# AND TYPE=#type#
